                                                                                                主席致辭附註

The development prospect of new energy is broad, firm and long-term. In                        新 能 源 發 展 前 景 廣 闊，堅 定 而 長 期。2021年，中 共 中

            Scientific and Technological Innovation                                      科技創新
            The Company has attached great importance to scientific and                  本 公 司 高 度 重 視 科 技 創 新，2021年 聚 焦 數 字 化
            technological innovation, in 2021, it focused on the directions of digital   智能運維工程、核心技術創新突破、信息化支撐
            intelligent operation and maintenance engineering, core technology           等方向，堅持科技創新的核心地位，以科技創新
            innovation breakthroughs, information technology support, among              引 領 新 能 源 高 質 量 發 展，助 力 構 建 新 型 電 力 系
            others, and insisted on the core position of technological innovation,       統，為實現「雙碳」戰略目標貢獻力量。
            led the high-quality development of new energy with technological

      Leung obtained a Bachelor Degree of Science in Business Administration (major in Accounting) from the University of The East in

      Certified Public Accountants since December 1996. He has been a member of the Hong Kong Securities and Investment Institute

      no involvement in any matters relating to Richly Field. During Mr. Leung’s tenure of directorship with Richly Field, Richly Field
      and its then subsidiaries were engaged in the building construction and maintenance industry including building work, design

       operation results of the Company, general financial position, cash flow            營 業 績、整 體 財 務 狀 況、現 金 流 量 狀 況、未 來 營
       position, future operating and capital needs, amount of distributable              運 及 資 本 需 求、可 分 配 溢 利 金 額、貸 款 契 據 限
       profit, restrictions under loan covenants, tax considerations, general             制、稅 務 考 慮、總 體 經 濟 狀 況、適 用 法 律 及 法 規
       economic conditions, applicable laws and regulations as well as other              以及董事會認為相關的其他因素而釐定。
       factors that the Board considers relevant.
